videos.title: I PLAYED Legend Of Zelda Ocarina of Time EARLY - Nintendo Switch 2
videos.description:
I played the new Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time EARLY for the Nintendo Switch 2.

I got around an hour of gameplay that was split between the intro of Link in Kokiri Forest, exploring Hyrule Field and as Adult Link in the Forest Temple. The HYPE for this game is so real, and it all felt so familiar in the best way. The updated visuals were stunning but the iconic soundtrack was by far the best part. Will 100% be game of the year for me and just hoping I can get my hands on the limited edition c

videos.title: Apple HomeView REVIEW - Is It Worth It?
videos.description:
mini review of the new Apple HomeView. Is it worth the price? 

This is Apple’s first smart home hub that has a square 7” Liquid Retina display. It’s built out of aluminum and comes in 4 colours: Space Grey, Silver, Starlight or Rose Pink. You can get it with a stand or wall mounted and it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI and seems to be running its own separate OS. Super useful for things like Handoff and controlling your smart home. $299 🇺🇸 / $429 🇨🇦 - What do you guys think?
